The '''T-13 Airspeeder''' was an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] manufactured by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. It could carry two people, a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and a passenger, seated in tandem.

==Behind the scenes==
The T-13 Airspeeder was identified in ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'' by way of an image caption under the drawing of an airspeeder. In the [[The Star Wars Sourcebook (Second Edition)|Second Edition]] of the sourcebook the image was retained but the caption was removed.
